title: Review of overtime and additional hours calculation (for Service NSW employees)
summary: This page provides information regarding the review of overtime and additional hours calculation for former Service NSW employees.
who_can_apply: Must have been an ongoing or temporary employee (excluding contractors) of Service NSW.
Must be a former employee of Service NSW who worked in a Service Centre, Contact Centre, Middle Office location, or at a Mobile Service Centre.
A person may be eligible for an assessment of backpay.
what_you_need: The registration form is for a former Service NSW employee (ongoing or temporary) or a person with authority to act on behalf of a former Service NSW employee.
